title: 12-Day Vietnam Grand North-to-South Golf Trilogy
description: The ultimate 12-day cross-country golf odyssey. Play Hanoi, Da Nang, and Ho Tram, staying at Capella Hanoi, Namia River Retreat, and The Bluffs.
destination: Hanoi, Da Nang & Ho Tram, Vietnam

signatureTour.title: The Grand Vietnam Odyssey
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our all-inclusive 14-day signature tour featuring private jet charters, presidential suites, and personal tour directors.

inclusions.detail: All private luxury ground transport in Hanoi, Da Nang, Hoi An, and Saigon/Ho Tram.
Business/Premium domestic flights connecting Hanoi to Da Nang and Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City.
6 championship rounds: Thanh Lanh Valley, Silk Path, Ba Na Hills, Hoiana Shores, The Bluffs, and Tan Son Nhat.
11 nights across Capella Hanoi, Namia River Retreat Hoi An, and The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram.
Continuous on-ground tour coordination and seamless luggage forwarding.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi & Opera District Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Northern Arrival
itinerary.imageAlt: Capella Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Hanoi and transfer to Capella Hanoi. Decompress from travel in your bespoke opera-themed suite.

Enjoy welcome drinks and a private dinner celebrating northern Vietnamese cuisine in the French Quarter.

itinerary.title: Alpine Splendor at Thanh Lanh Valley Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Faldo Valley Challenge
itinerary.imageCaption: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Sir Nick Faldo’s magnificent Thanh Lanh Valley Golf & Resort, enjoying alpine mountain scenery and lakeside holes at 1,000 meters elevation.

Return to Hanoi for an evening exploring the vibrant Old Quarter culinary scene.

itinerary.title: Championship Parkland at Silk Path Dong Trieu
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Modern Parkland Test
itinerary.imageCaption: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play the newly opened championship course at Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf, enjoying flawless conditioning and sculptured bunkers.

Conclude your northern stay with an exquisite dinner at Capella’s Michelin-starred Koki restaurant.

itinerary.title: Flight to Da Nang & Private Pool Villa Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Central Transition
itinerary.imageCaption: Namia River Retreat — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Namia River Retreat luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Fly south to Da Nang and transfer to your private pool villa at Namia River Retreat in Hoi An.

Spend the afternoon relaxing beside your private plunge pool before an evening stroll through UNESCO-listed Hoi An Ancient Town.

itinerary.title: Mountain Foothills at Ba Na Hills Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Donald Mountain Gem
itinerary.imageCaption: Ba Na Hills Golf Club — Luke Donald / IMG (Par 72, 7,858 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Ba Na Hills Golf Club championship golf course Luke Donald / IMG Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle Luke Donald's mountain showpiece at Ba Na Hills Golf Club, navigating dramatic elevation shifts and pristine Paspalum fairways.

Return to Namia for an evening 90-minute restorative herbal spa treatment.

itinerary.title: Pure Coastal Links at Hoiana Shores Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 4: RTJ II Dunes Links
itinerary.imageCaption: Hoiana Shores Golf Club — Robert Trent Jones Jr. (Par 72, 7,309 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Hoiana Shores Golf Club championship golf course Robert Trent Jones Jr. Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Experience Robert Trent Jones II’s seaside triumph at Hoiana Shores Golf Club, playing firm, fast links golf exposed to coastal ocean breezes.

Celebrate with clubhouse drinks overlooking the Cham Islands before a riverside dinner in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hoi An Rest Day & Private Sunset Boat Cruise
itinerary.subtitle: Rest & Restoration
itinerary.imageCaption: Namia River Retreat — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Namia River Retreat luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A dedicated rest day midway through the cross-country tour. Relax by the pool, explore artisan tailor shops, or visit the beach.

Board a private wooden riverboat for champagne and hors d'oeuvres on the Thu Bon River at sunset.

itinerary.title: Flight to Saigon & Coastal Drive to Ho Tram
itinerary.subtitle: Southern Transition
itinerary.imageCaption: The Grand Ho Tram Strip — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Grand Ho Tram Strip luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Fly to Ho Chi Minh City and travel via executive coach to the southern coast, checking in to The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram.

Unpack in your ocean-view room and enjoy a beachfront sunset dinner.

itinerary.title: Greg Norman’s Rugged Dunes at The Bluffs Ho Tram
itinerary.subtitle: Round 5: World Top 100 Links
itinerary.imageCaption: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram — Greg Norman (Par 71, 7,207 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram championship golf course Greg Norman Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on Greg Norman’s acclaimed World Top 100 masterpiece, The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram, playing through towering coastal dunes 50 meters above the sea.

Relax in the clubhouse overlooking the crashing waves before an evening at the resort.

itinerary.title: The Bluffs Ho Tram Replay & Beachfront Relaxation
itinerary.subtitle: Round 6: Coastal Championship Replay
itinerary.imageCaption: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram — Greg Norman (Par 71, 7,207 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram championship golf course Greg Norman Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Return to The Bluffs for a second round, mastering the wind and rolling sand dunes with tactical precision.

Spend the afternoon on the beach or by the pool before a celebratory private seafood barbecue.

itinerary.title: Return to Saigon & Final City Evening
itinerary.subtitle: Metropolitan Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: The Grand Ho Tram Strip — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Grand Ho Tram Strip luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Transfer back to Ho Chi Minh City, checking in for a final night of urban luxury.

Gather for a grand tour-ending dinner at a premier Saigon dining venue, toasting 12 days of exceptional cross-country golf.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Tan Son Nhat Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: The Grand Ho Tram Strip — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: The Grand Ho Tram Strip luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast before packing your clubs with assistance from your AGS concierge.

Your private luxury transfer delivers you to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for your return flight home, concluding the grand Vietnam trilogy.

faqs.question: How is luggage handled during internal flights?
faqs.answer: Your AGS tour director coordinates seamless luggage and golf bag transfers directly between hotels and airports, ensuring hands-free travel.
